metadata.description: A curated public subset of Claude Code plugins: trip planning, audio transcription, meeting notes, and a session-cost stamp, plus the audio-transcription eval harness.

plugins.name: trip-plan
plugins.description: Itinerary days sequenced around opening hours, travel time and bookings, then shipped as an installable offline app.

plugins.name: audio-transcription
plugins.description: Recordings into timestamped, searchable Markdown with Whisper: meetings, calls, interviews, lectures, podcasts.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: A folder of transcripts into one readable summary per meeting: TLDR, decisions, and action items with owners.

plugins.name: session-cost-stamp
plugins.description: Stamps each session's worked time, context % and cost into its own title, visible in the sessions list and on resume.
